messages:
sam: Heads-up — created RC candidate 3.1.0-rc3. Image: rwinference/serve:20260322-rc3. Requesting pin + promo during the next quiet window. Quiet window begins in 30m.

dev-deploy-bot: CI smoke checks ✅ (3/3). Artifact pinned: deploy.pin(rwinference/serve,20260322-rc3). Staging and prod-candidate pools updated.

maya: Noted. We should pre-warm KV cache for embed-service this time. Last cold-run spiked p95 on generation.

luis: Agreed. Plan: /ops/kv-warm --service embed-service --shards 0-5 --duration 10m. Kickoff ~12m before traffic shift.

sam: Rollout plan: canary 5% (10m) -> 25% (20m) -> gradual to 100%. Telemetry gates only. Abort if error rate >= 0.5% OR p95 >= 1.35x baseline. Watch gen_quality evals for regressions.

irene: Quick check: no DB migrations or feature flags in this RC — purely model binary + quant profile. That makes rollback lightweight.

dev-deploy-bot: Pre-promo checklist: artifacts pinned, smoke green, KV warm hook available, canary policy configured. Promote command: /deploy promote --pin 20260322-rc3 --rollout canary:5,25,100

maya: I'll trigger kv-warm 10m ahead. @peter (oncall) will own live metric watch and trigger abort if token-cost or p95 cross thresholds. Please ack?

peter (oncall): ack. I'll set alerts and keep /dash/rc3-canary open. If anything anomalous in the first 10m I will call rollback.

luis: Quick rollback snippet copied here:

/deploy rollback --service rwinference/serve --to 20260319-rc2

Keep 20260319-rc2 pinned in staging for fast rollforward.

sam: Release notes delta: "improve batching heuristics for KV cache reuse; quant profile v2 reduces memory ~12%; tighten logging around kernel selection." Pushing to release-notes/3.1.0-rc3.md now.

irene: Add fallback model note: model-small-quant will be available as an automatic fallback if memory pressure triggers OOMs.

maya: KV warm started at 1775022330. Warmers running shards 0-5.

dev-deploy-bot: Promo window opens at 1775022420. Will post roll steps and timestamps as progress updates.

sam: If no objections by T-2m we proceed. Please respond with :thumbsup: to approve.

maya: :thumbsup:

luis: :thumbsup: monitoring ready

irene: :white_check_mark: approved

peter (oncall): :eyes: standing by

dev-deploy-bot: Promotion started — 5% canary at 1775022450. Metrics streaming to /dash/rc3-canary.

sam: Monitoring first 10m now. Will call ramp at +10m if gates pass.

dev-deploy-bot: Canary passed initial gate. Ramping to 25% at 1775022550.

peter (oncall): Observed a small bump in token-cost at canary start (+6%). Watching. No abort yet.

sam: Reminder: abort criteria still error rate >= 0.5% OR p95 >= 1.35x baseline. Call rollback if either crosses.

luis: Rollback ready command is final in ops runbook. Keeping the older artifact pinned and ready.

sam: Thanks all — will post final promo confirmation once 100% completes or if we need roll forward.

dev-deploy-bot: Full promotion complete at 1775022600. Release notes published. :rocket:
